correctness.rationale: For arbitrary t>=3 and all q_i>=0 the only forbidden faces are C and {c_i} union W_ij. Without C the complex factors as a join of local A_i, each a union of two contractible subcomplexes intersecting in a join of simplex boundaries. Its central-face star B and intersection P give an exact MV sequence. If any q_i=0, both X and B are contractible and P->K is a homology isomorphism; K and P are simply connected except the explicitly direct t=3,q=0 case, so they are homotopy equivalent. If all q_i>=1, the join of the local primitive integral suspension cycles gives a generator of top H_D(X); the unique all-central term proves the MV connecting map to H_{D-1}(P) is ±1, hence K integral-acyclic. Its complete one-skeleton and the explicit filling of each forbidden triangle prove pi_1(K)=0 for t=3; for t>=4 K contains the complete two-skeleton. Thus K is contractible. The independent verifier checked 57 small parameter cases and all complete mod-two Betti vectors but is not used as infinite proof.

General cover-ideal resolution statements are of a different invariant and no implication to this full integral homotopy classification was located.

value.rationale: A complete infinite-parameter classification for naturally occurring block graphs, for all clique orders t>=3 and arbitrary nonuniform pendant multiplicities, refines a 2026 qualitative shellability theorem. The theorem identifies a sharp global saturation boundary: a single missing central attachment retains precisely one integral sphere of dimension (q+1)(t-2), whereas covering every central vertex kills all homotopy. The explicit primitive MV connecting-map mechanism explains the transition and is a structural conclusion, not a routine tiny finite increment.
